Remote

Overview

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Analyst to join our technology group, focusing on production support and management of technical environments. This role will support the day‑to‑day operations of applications, manage infrastructure projects, and collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth development, testing, and release cycles. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent organizational skills, and a proactive approach to problem‑solving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain various environments (database, web, and application servers) for development, testing, and releases, including scheduling and coordinating environment refreshes/resets.
  • Create and manage Azure DevOps releases, overseeing deployment pipelines, builds, and associated tasks.
  • Lead infrastructure projects, such as server upgrades, assessing and addressing impacts on applications and users, including Disaster Recovery testing (scheduling, overseeing, and documenting).
  • Collaborate with onshore, nearshore, and offshore development, infrastructure, cloud, security, and support teams to perform periodic maintenance tasks, such as password rotations and SSL certificate renewals.
  • Investigate bug causes, coordinate fixes, and support testing with cross‑functional teams.
  • Create and manage tickets for production support, ensuring compliance with SOX and regulatory procedures through coordination with Change and Release control teams.
  • Communicate with application users regarding system status and specific issues they raise.
  • Develop a deep understanding of applications and business processes to create and execute test and release plans.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for applications, processes, and projects.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and workflow automations.
  • Research and propose solutions leveraging existing and emerging technologies.
  • Maintain a workboard (e.g., in Asana) to keep management and project leaders informed of status, efforts, and issues.
  • Attend scheduled meetings and work primarily on a US East Coast schedule (ET 09:00 – 17:00), with occasional availability outside regular hours for critical production support.

Required Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps, particularly in deployment processes (pipelines, builds, repository management, version review, and error handling).
  • Strong understanding of server and network architecture.
  • Knowledge of web development tools and architectures.
  • Familiarity with relational database concepts and structures.
  • Experience with development, testing, and release cycles in an Agile environment.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with end‑users and development teams.
  • Strong organizational skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Self‑motivated with a proactive approach to initiating, pursuing, and resolving issues.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to precision.
  • Comfortable reading and writing requirements and test scripts.
  • Willingness to work outside regular business hours for critical production support when needed.

Recommended Skills

  • Proficiency in MSSQL (T‑SQL).
  • Experience with Slack (Workflow Builder, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Asana (Workflow Builder, etc.).
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Office 365, including Excel macros.
  • Familiarity with MS PowerApps.
  • Experience with ETL tools such as Alteryx.
  • Bilingualism (Spanish and English) to support communication with a global workforce and user base.
  • Familiarity with the broadcast industry and signal distribution technologies.
  • Experience with automation and workflow/process tools.

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, employees, and Pros grow and succeed together. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

Role Overview:

As a Payment Support Specialist, you are the external voice to our service professionals (our Pros) on all matters payments-related. You are a great communicator who is comfortable engaging in difficult conversations. You listen well, establish rapport quickly, and can transmit complex information in a straightforward manner. You support investigations into high-risk accounts and transactions and troubleshoot technical errors. As a direct connection to our Pros, you are responsible for sharing insights with risk, product, engineering, and customer success teams to help us champion their success. Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

What you do each day:

  • Point of contact with customers via written and verbal communication regarding payments issues (i.e. lending, account takeovers, debt collection, account reconciliation, high risk transactions)
  • Assist pros with securing accounts and provide best practices for maintaining account security
  • Interpret and assist with reconciliation of merchant services account ledger.
  • Troubleshoot issues and provide assistance to a broad base of customers
  • Provide Pros with best practices on chargeback prevention and mitigation, and support chargeback evidence collection and submission
  • Communicate with engineering and product teams to identify and problem-solve technical errors
  • Collaborate with Risk team regarding high-risk accounts, transactions, and activity

Qualifications:

  • 1-2 years of experience in full-time customer support, account management, or sales
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Experience with Stripe or other merchant service provider
  • Tech support experience preferred
  • Bachelor's degree preferred

What will help you succeed:

  • High attention to detail
  • Excellent reading comprehension
  • Experience in developing relationships with customers
  • Professional attitude and demeanor when interacting with others

As MetaCTO’s Content Marketing Manager , you’ll own the storytelling engine that powers our brand growth. You’ll transform client wins, technical breakthroughs, and leadership insights into content that attracts leads, strengthens partnerships, and builds authority in the mobile and AI ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with founders, project managers, and engineers to uncover the real value behind our projects and turn it into stories that resonate with startups and product leaders worldwide.

What You’ll Do

1. Case Studies & Success Stories

  • Interview clients and engineers to capture narratives of innovation and measurable results.

  • Collaborate with design and marketing to publish across MetaCTO.com, Clutch, and partner platforms.

2. Newsletters & Email Marketing

  • Plan and write monthly newsletters highlighting product launches, insights, and client stories.

  • Maintain a 90‑day content calendar covering website, email, and social channels.

  • Streamline workflows and templates to make content production fast and repeatable.

4. Brand & Voice Development

  • Maintain a consistent brand tone—clear, confident, and optimistic.
  • Ensure all content reflects MetaCTO’s values: clarity, speed, and technical depth.

5. Analytics & Optimization

  • Track key performance metrics and present quarterly reports on content effectiveness.
  • Identify new opportunities for SEO growth and inbound lead generation.

Key Objectives (Quarterly OKRs)

  • O1: Strengthen MetaCTO’s credibility through storytelling – Publish 4+ new case studies per quarter, increase engagement and shares, expand visibility on partner and client platforms.
  • O2: Build and engage an audience of potential clients and partners – Launch a monthly newsletter with strong engagement, grow email subscribers and LinkedIn followers, generate inbound leads through content.
  • O3: Systematize and scale content production – Establish templates and workflows, reduce leadership time on content creation by 50%.

Ideal Candidate

  • Based in Brazil , fluent in English and Portuguese .
  • 3–6 years of experience in B2B tech or agency content marketing .
  • Strong storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical achievements into business value.
  • Proven experience writing case studies, newsletters, or blog content for software or AI companies.
  • Proficiency with marketing tools (HubSpot, Notion, Google Analytics, LinkedIn).
  • Bonus: familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Jasper) or SEO best practices.

Why Join MetaCTO

  • Collaborate directly with U.S. founders and engineers on impactful projects.
  • Remote‑first culture, flexible schedule, and creative autonomy.
  • Work with cutting‑edge technologies and tools (Claude, ChatGPT, SwiftUI, Kotlin, etc.).
  • Contribute to a company where storytelling directly drives growth and brand visibility.

Position Details

  • Type: Full‑time or Part‑time (Contract‑to‑Hire)
  • Location: 100% Remote (Brazil‑based)
  • Time Zone: Flexible with overlap for U.S. Pacific Time collaboration

Send your portfolio , writing samples , and a brief note on why MetaCTO’s mission inspires you to . Subject line: Content Marketing Manager (Brazil) – (Your Name)

Building the Future of Crypto

Our Krakenites are a world-class team with crypto conviction, united by our desire to discover and unlock the potential of crypto and blockchain technology.

What makes us different?

Kraken is a mission-focused company rooted in crypto values. As a Krakenite, you’ll join us on our mission to accelerate the global adoption of crypto, so that everyone can achieve financial freedom and inclusion. For over a decade, Kraken’s focus on our mission and crypto ethos has attracted many of the most talented crypto experts in the world.

Before you apply, please read the Kraken Culture page to learn more about our internal culture, values, and mission. We also expect candidates to familiarize themselves with the Kraken app. Learn how to create a Kraken account here.

As a fully remote company, we have Krakenites in 70+ countries who speak over 50 languages. Krakenites are industry pioneers who develop premium crypto products for experienced traders, institutions, and newcomers to the space. Kraken is committed to industry-leading security, crypto education, and world-class client support through our products like Kraken Pro, Desktop, Wallet, and Kraken Futures.

Become a Krakenite and build the future of crypto!

Proof of work

The team

We’re hiring Data Analysts to join our Compliance Enterprise Client Data Office team, working remotely from India! This role is centered on building and enhancing compliance dashboarding, analytics, and insights — the core responsibility of the position. The candidate must be passionate about creating dashboards that deliver clear, actionable insights, as this will be the main focus of the role.

As a Data Analyst, you will own core responsibilities such as designing scalable compliance dashboards, analytics, and metrics, architecting automated pipelines and audit-ready regulatory reports, and translating plain-language business or regulatory requests into precise data models. You’ll partner closely with leaders across Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to strengthen our compliance posture and ensure regulators and executives have visibility into accurate, meaningful insights. Your ability to contextualize data within the broader business and risk landscape, and communicate those insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, will be essential.

In addition to these core responsibilities, you will also provide ad-hoc support where needed: managing data requests, assisting with regulatory reporting, supporting automation and peer code reviews, and developing tactical solutions that free up Product and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements. The ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, communicate effectively in a fully remote environment, and leverage AI to create scalable frameworks will be key to success.

Ultimately, this is a critical role shaping Kraken’s compliance and client data strategy, aligning data practices with ambitious business objectives, and navigating the complexities of an evolving regulatory landscape with rigor, creativity, and precision.

The opportunity

  • Develop and maintain high-quality data sources in partnership with Data and Engineering teams.

  • Build key datasets and data pipelines using Python and ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow).

We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.

  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought‑leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near‑zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in‑house). You know the category patterns - and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low‑ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points if You...

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb‑stop, offer framing, mobile‑first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

Start part‑time freelance; earn your way into a full‑time seat in = 12 months through results.

Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.

Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What do Include

Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work). For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal your role outcome (metrics if possible). Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets). Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

Conduzir análises de dados, métricas de produto e insights do mercado digital para embasar decisões.

Atuar próximo a infoprodutores (sellers), entendendo suas jornadas e necessidades, e traduzindo-as em experiências escaláveis e inovadoras.

Experiência comprovada em EdTech ou Infoproduto, especialmente em plataformas de infoproduto.

Experiência em Agilidade (Scrum/Kanban): participação em ritos, escrita de histórias de usuário e colaboração próxima com times de desenvolvimento.

Experiência em Marketing Digital: entendimento de funis de conversão, métricas de engajamento e estratégias de crescimento aplicadas ao mercado de educação.

Capacidade analítica para tomar decisões baseadas em dados e métricas de produto (churn, LTV, MRR, engajamento, etc.).

Diferenciais

Conhecimento análise em Mercado de infoproduto.

Experiência prévia como Product Design, Product Manager ou funções correlatas.

Forte habilidade de comunicação e negociação com stakeholders internos e externos.

Proatividade e autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos.

  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

title: Banco de Talentos [A-LAB] - FREELA
description:
Overview

Somos diversos, somos sonhadores e temos o propósito de inspirar nossa comunidade a contar histórias reais com impacto positivo. É por isso que misturamos nossas paixões com trabalho. Dessa forma, queremos conhecer novos talentos que estejam dispostos a trabalhar conosco em formato de freelas. Queremos, cada vez mais, deixar nossas equipes plurais e diversas.

Então, se você quer participar e co-criar histórias e projetos temporários conosco, queremos te conhecer! Se você é freelancer, cadastre-se no banco de talentos e analisaremos seu perfil de acordo com cada uma das oportunidades.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Áreas de atuação

  • Direção de arte

É necessário criar conceitos inovadores alinhados aos objetivos de cada marca, além de traduzir ideias criativas em narrativas visuais claras e objetivas. O diretor de arte precisa enxergar estrategicamente além do briefing, contribuindo na confecção das entregas.

Os motions precisam ter conhecimentos em After Effects e Adobe Premier, além de contribuir com referências visuais de animação e criar novas propostas, para animar as artes criadas por diretores de arte.

  • Redação

Os redatores devem ter pensamentos inovadores e uma curiosidade especial para novos formatos e plataformas. É preciso criar conceitos, roteirizar e escrever copies para peças em formatos objetivos e diferentes formatos, otimizando a comunicação de cada rede.

  • Analista de Conteúdo

Os analistas de conteúdo devem transformar estratégias em ações, ajudando a equipe de social nos briefings e ideias para redes sociais. São responsáveis por definir a volumetria ideal de cada rede, montar a grade de conteúdo de forma estratégica e buscar insights.

O estrategista é responsável por definir toda a estratégia de conteúdo de uma marca, além de desenvolver projetos criativos para as redes sociais, cuidar da qualidade do trabalho e definir o tom de voz da marca.

O time de B.I. é responsável por mapear oportunidades para as marcas na redes sociais, sejam elas tendências, comportamentos ou perfis do consumidor. É necessário ter um olhar criativo para poder transformá-lo em insights, estudos e insumos pra criação.

O produtor acompanha e gerencia todas as etapas da produção: desde a definição do cronograma até a entrega final. Ajuda a controlar a pauta dos motions e editores, faz orçamentos e contrato de terceiros.

O gerente de projetos é responsável pela liderança interna do time, organizando a pauta, fazendo o cronograma dos projetos e tendo a visão macro de quais demandas precisam ser priorizadas.

Gerir, cuidar, liderar e desenvolver pessoas do time são algumas das competências de quem realiza atendimento ao cliente. Além disso, é responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente e cuidado com o escopo de cada projeto.

Contratação PJ.

Oi, somos o A-Lab!

Um laboratório de conteúdo criativo que acredita que, nesse mundo de transformações constantes, algoritmos e inteligência artificial, existe uma coisa que não muda: a importância das boas relações.

Tudo que criamos reflete o cuidado e o interesse real que temos pelas pessoas. São essas conexões verdadeiras que impulsionam nossa habilidade de contar histórias mais autênticas, relevantes e integradas às necessidades das marcas e do público.

Exploramos linguagens, narrativas e formatos para ajudar nossos clientes a construírem comunidades engajadas. Já realizamos projetos em parceria com grandes marcas como Burger King, Uber, Faber Castell, Sorvetes Nestlé, Porto e Itaú .

Sabemos que o bem-estar no trabalho é determinante para gerar motivação diante de um mercado tão acelerado e competitivo. Por isso, temos uma cultura organizacional forte, que estimula as relações saudáveis e oferece condições para que nosso time se sinta confiante inspirado para criar.

Cultivamos um ambiente leve e prezamos por uma troca mútua de respeito e transparência. Incentivamos a colaboração e buscamos conectar as paixões individuais dos a-labers com o que fazemos no dia a dia. É isso que nos faz crescer juntos e ser um lugar de potência para quem está se desenvolvendo com a gente.

NOSSO propósito é provar para o mundo que entregas incríveis nascem de relações saudáveis. Bora colocá-las em prática juntos?

You’ll translate complex features into simple, engaging visuals that drive understanding and adoption. While your focus is on marketing, you will also contribute to our product’s visual language by designing UI components and in‑app graphics, ensuring a cohesive user journey from the first ad to the final click.   • Uphold and evolve our brand identity, ensuring a pixel‑perfect, cohesive experience across all marketing and product touchpoints.

What We Really Need From You

  • Proven experience as a graphic designer, with a strong portfolio showcasing marketing materials and digital assets.
  • Exceptional typographic skills with an eye for clean, modern design.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.
  • Strong experience designing UI components and web assets ready for development with clear specifications.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects efficiently, producing high‑quality designs under tight deadlines.
  • Strong understanding of digital design requirements, including web, social media, and email marketing assets.
  • Experience working independently while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a passion for delivering consistent, polished work.
  • A proactive attitude toward problem‑solving and design innovation.

What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay that reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote with a 8 AM–5 PM CST Monday‑Friday schedule.
  • Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth‑oriented culture: an inclusive, international team where your contributions make a tangible difference.

Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, and your unique perspective will help shape the future of small business growth.

This is a pivotal moment in our journey — moving from an agency to a SaaS‑first company. Your ideas and work will directly shape the success of our product and small businesses alike. Let’s shape the future of small business growth together!

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome)

About the Opportunity

We’re building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part‑time contributor into a core, full‑time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day‑to‑day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product‑adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion‑ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one‑pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end‑to‑end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self‑serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought‑leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near‑zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in‑house). You know the category patterns – and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you’ve got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low‑ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points if You…

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb‑stop, offer framing, mobile‑first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

About the Opportunity

We’re building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to own day‑to‑day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.

  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion‑ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one‑pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end‑to‑end: insight, moodboard, concept, production, iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self‑serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought‑leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near‑zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in‑house).
  • Know the category patterns – and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and restraint where it matters.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you have references at your fingertips.

  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with.

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Produce quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb‑stop, offer framing, mobile‑first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

Application Requirements

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.
  • Share your LinkedIn and portfolio; optional Loom shows personality.

Seniority Level

  • Mid‑Senior level

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Fully Remote
Type: Full time, Permanent
Team: Daydream - Incubated by Livepeer

About Daydream

Daydream is building the Hugging Face of real-time, interactive video AI: a powerful, open-source platform and vibrant community of developers, researchers, and creatives working together to advance the next generation of cutting-edge AI models and interactivity.

The Product

Daydream’s real time video AI & community platform includes:

  • The leading interactive AI platform for Touch Designer and StreamDiffusion
  • The leading knowledge base & community hub for real time AI and world models
  • A community of over 2,000 creative technologists, builders, and applied researchers

Daydream is a part of Livepeer, powering interactive live streaming for a global customer base, from top 15 global companies to world famous festivals like Burning Man.

The Role

We are looking to hire an execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to join our ever growing marketing team. Initially, the role would involve helping us understand and connect with our users, crafting the story of the product, producing content, developing launch plans and coordinating those launches, and helping with partnerships enablement.

What you’ll do

Craft the Story: Develop clear, compelling narratives around our product, features, and vision.

Launch & GTM: Plan and execute product and feature launches. Collaborate on distribution strategies across channels like X, Discord, Reddit, newsletters, community platforms, and earned media.

Content Production: Write or coordinate blog posts, landing pages, technical explainers, and demo content that resonates with our users.

Partnerships Enablement: Create decks, one-pagers, and case studies to support partnership and sales efforts.

Measure & Iterate: Track engagement, growth, and feedback to continuously refine messaging, positioning, and marketing strategies.

Vendor Management: Collaborate with external agencies, freelancers, and partners to scale marketing output efficiently. This includes drafting clear briefs, setting expectations and timelines, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring work is aligned with brand voice, quality standards, and strategic goals.

Reporting: Create regular performance reports on campaigns, launches, and content, providing insights and recommendations to guide strategic decisions.

About you

Must-have experience

Background in AI or Developer Tools: You’ve marketed a product in the AI space and can speak the language of developers and technical audiences.

Strong Execution Skills: You move fast, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver high-quality work on time.

Excellent Storyteller: You know how to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling messages.

Creative & Curious: You're excited to experiment, iterate, and help shape a new product in an emerging category.

Open Source Familiarity: Bonus points if you’ve worked with or marketed open-source projects before.

Remote Collaboration Skills: You’re self-directed, organized, and great at async communication in a distributed team.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Salary: We will offer a competitive market rate based on experience and location.
  • Token package: Competitive token package with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • Employee Stock Option Plan: Competitive ESOP with 4-year vesting and a 1-year cliff.
  • Annual Adjusted Salaries: Every January, we review and adjust pay.
  • Holidays: 25 vacation days per year plus any national holidays. A day off on your birthday, because you deserve to celebrate! (If it falls on a weekend, take another day off that week.)
  • Learning and Development Budget: 2,000 USD per year to invest in courses, certifications, or workshops to grow in your role.
  • Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance in applicable locations.
  • Pension: Company pension contributions in applicable locations.
  • Equipment: Choose a laptop of your preference and anything you need for a comfortable work setup (we’ll purchase it for you)
  • Home Office Upgrades: 300 USD every two years to refresh your workspace at home.
  • Flexible Working: Flexible hours to support work-life balance.
  • Annual Company Retreat: Once a year, we fly the whole company to an exciting global location for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun—all expenses covered
  • Team Meetups: Each team comes together in person once a year to build trust, spark ideas, and share meaningful moments that go beyond the screen.
  • Subscription Gift: 250 USD per year to spend on a personal subscription of your choice.
  • Work Anniversary Rewards: At Livepeer, we love recognising your journey. As you reach 3, 4, 5 years and beyond, you'll be celebrated with gift card rewards.
  • Celebrate Life’s Big Moments: Whether it’s a wedding, a new baby, or another major milestone, we’ll mark the occasion with a celebration gift.
  • Referral Bonus: Refer great talent to Livepeer and earn 100 LPT tokens when they’re hired and successfully complete their probation.
  • Latest Tech: Work with cutting-edge AI and the latest technologies alongside an innovative and entrepreneurial team.

Apply Now!

Join Daydream and shape the future of video streaming and AI tooling!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Through our products and services we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds and is guided by core values of integrity, ownership, passion for progress, and empathy.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate will support end users, manage endpoints, automate identity and access management, and administer cloud‑based IT systems and tools. The role demands a balance of hands‑on technical work, automation, and customer support, within a rapidly growing, security‑first environment.

Responsibilities

  • Provide first‑line support to employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels.
  • Procuring, delivering, and onboarding technology equipment for new hires; managing tech retrieval for outgoing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute to knowledge base improvements.
  • Manage SaaS applications – Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, and others.
  • Configure and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf).
  • Improve identity and access tools (GSuite, Okta, SSO) and automate related workflows.
  • Write help articles, run scripts, and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Respond to, manage, and resolve critical incidents and issues.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets and balance multiple projects within sprints using Jira and agile methods.
  • Set and work toward objective and key results with minimal direction, aligning personal goals with team and company objectives.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Proficiency in automating with Bash, Zsh, Python, and open‑source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows.
  • API integration skills across systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple time zones and shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills – clear, friendly, concise across all media.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, Slack, and documentation.
  • Security awareness, including PGP knowledge.
  • Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, and OSI troubleshooting.
  • Self‑management, scope projects accurately, and balance priorities across teams.
  • Organizational and task‑management skills; comfortable with ambiguity.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with AWS environments.
  • Use of command‑line interfaces for GAM and similar tools.
  • Certifications: Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace.

Culture Fit

  • Adaptable and resilient in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset: eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner, capable of influencing across functions with empathy and clarity.
  • Integrity and accountability when handling confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Remote‑working experience.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO program.
  • Company ownership and shared equity.
  • Remote work potential up to 180 days worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose‑driven career in a leading digital asset company.

Working Environment & Application Process

Our team is truly global across North America, Latin America, South Africa, and Europe. We operate as a remote‑first environment. Due to high application volume, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response or provide publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters; unsolicited agency resumes are not accepted.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

title: Cientista de Dados Junior
description:
A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Desenvolvemos líderes de excelência e, unidos por valores pautados pela ética e pelo compromisso constante com a qualidade, contribuímos para gerar confiança no mercado de capitais e em economias em todo o mundo. Dessa forma, exercemos um papel crítico na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor para nossos profissionais, nossos clientes e nossas comunidades.

Quase 35.000 profissionais especializados em atender a indústria financeira em todo o mundo, prestam serviços de auditoria, impostos, transações e assessoria empresarial para bancos, seguradoras e gestoras de patrimônio. Nas Américas, é a única organização de contabilidade pública com uma unidade de negócios dedicada a este mercado. A EY é líder em servir o mercado global de serviços financeiros.

O Financial Services Office hoje inclui mais de 4.000 profissionais em 50 localidades por todo EUA, Caribe e América Latina, com especializações que nos permite obter uma compreensão ampla das questões de negócios e dos desafios do setor financeiro, bem como oferecer serviços integrados para nossos clientes. No Brasil atuam junto aos principais centros mundiais para compartilhar conhecimento relacionado às tendências e regulamentações atuais e emergentes, a fim de ajudar nossos clientes a resolver questões fundamentais em gestão de riscos, controles internos, estratégia, operações e tecnologia da informação.

Este grupo de profissionais, dinâmico e talentoso, busca neste momento o candidato certo para integrar o time e desenvolver uma carreira sólida e ascendente.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). Entregamos soluções sob medida com base nas necessidades específicas de cada negócio, a partir de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas com diferentes perfis, como especialistas em Dados, UX, até analistas de negócios e scrum masters.

TechEY

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como Cientista de Dados Junior você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltados para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

Poderá atuar diretamente com as tecnologias mais avançadas de IA Generativa e LLMs (como GPT, LLaMA e Mistral). Ambiente inovador, com forte incentivo à pesquisa aplicada e experimentação em IA. Terá oportunidade de participar do desenvolvimento de soluções reais e escaláveis. Cultura colaborativa e times multidisciplinares. Possibilidade de crescimento acelerado e envolvimento em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você em nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e ou correlatas;
  • Ampla experiência em Python, especialmente para aplicações de IA. Domínio de frameworks de LLMs (ex: Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain, OpenAI API);
  • Proficiência com pipelines de dados, ETL, Apache NiFi, Apache Kafka. Prática com versionamento de código (ex: Git), testes automatizados e programação orientada a objetos;
  • Vivência com integração entre sistemas via APIs ou mensagens. Prompt engineering e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura técnica e ferramentas.

Desejável - Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA ou Data Science, preferencialmente em empresas do setor financeiro, como bancos e seguradoras, tecnologia, consultorias ou startups;
  • Atuação em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e participação em comunidades ou projetos open source de IA.
  • Familiaridade com publicações, artigos, ou apresentações em eventos de tecnologia.
  • Experiência prévia com validação humana de modelos (human-in-the-loop).
  • Certificações em Data Science (ex: IBM Data Science, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer), ou cursos reconhecidos em Machine Learning, IA ou Big Data.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Como Cientista de Dados você atuará na evolução de modelos baseados em LLMs, desde o prompt engineering até a implantação em produção;
  • Será responsável por criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando ferramentas de mercado (NiFi, Kafka);
  • Irá automatizar processos de ETL e integração entre sistemas;
  • Irá garantir a qualidade, versionamento e testabilidade das soluções desenvolvidas e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY Brasil.

O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Assim, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

Saiba mais sobre como é trabalhar na EY:

Carreiras na EY LinkedIn @EY Instagram @eybrasilcarreiras

A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados em nossos processos.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of proven experience in B2B and B2C marketing, preferably in education, certifications, or language qualifications
  • Demonstrated success running webinars, digital campaigns, and thought leadership initiatives across multiple markets
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; additional language skills for LATAM markets a plus
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools, platforms, and campaign analytics
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and teamwork skills; metrics-driven with a creative mindset
  • Self-driven, flexible, and able to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
  • Attention to detail with a proactive approach to driving results

What We Offer

  • Competitive remuneration package

Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state‑of‑the‑art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, and Integrity are the core values which guide everything we do. Our offices in the UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to reflecting the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Overview

At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Job Description

We are looking for a talented individual…

To join our team as an Implementation Lead who plays a pivotal role in driving the successful delivery of technology solutions across multiple programs and clients. The Lead is expected to provide strategic and operational leadership to teams of Implementation Consultants, ensuring consistency, quality, and scalability in delivery. The Lead also provides Customer Success Manager services for key or high-impact clients, acting as a trusted advisor and escalation point. This role is ideal for a seasoned implementation professional with a strong grasp of enterprise delivery, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination.

Prefer candidates based in MD, PA, NJ, DC or VA to attend in person client meetings.

Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Strategic Implementation Leadership
    • Oversee and guide multiple concurrent implementation projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and platform strategy.
    • Serve as a mentor and escalation point for Implementation Consultants, providing guidance on complex configurations, client challenges, and delivery risks.
    • Establish and enforce implementation standards, templates, and best practices across projects
  • Client & Stakeholder Management
    • Act as the primary relationship lead for designated high-impact clients, ensuring their needs are understood, prioritized, and addressed throughout the implementation lifecycle.
    • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, aligning platform capabilities with their strategic goals.
    • Prepare and deliver clear, concise presentations on implementation strategies, project progress, and key outcomes to stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including executive leadership.
  • Cross-Project Coordination & Governance
    • Coordinate across multiple project teams to ensure resource alignment, risk mitigation, and consistent delivery quality.
    • Collaborate with shared services (e.g., development, QA, support) to prioritize and sequence work across projects.
    • Monitor project health metrics and proactively address delivery risks and dependencies.
  • Implementation Oversight & Standards Assurance
    • Provide oversight for implementation activities across projects, ensuring configurations and processes align with platform standards, business requirements, and organizational best practices.
    • Review outputs from requirement gathering and solutioning sessions led by Implementation Consultants to ensure deliverables meet expectations, are feasible, and align with strategic goals.
    • Ensure all implementations adhere to platform standards, compliance requirements, and scalability principles, and that documentation is complete, consistent, and aligned with organizational guidelines.
  • Training & Support
    • Identify opportunities to streamline implementation processes and improve delivery efficiency.
    • Lead retrospectives and post-mortems to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.
    • Contribute to the evolution of the implementation methodology and knowledge base.
  • Training & Enablement
    • Coach and support Implementation Consultants in developing their technical and client-facing skills.
    • Lead internal training sessions and contribute to onboarding materials for new team members.
    • Serve as a subject matter expert for platform capabilities and implementation strategy.

In this exciting career opportunity, you will have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in implementation, consulting, or project leadership roles, preferably in a SaaS or professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex client relationships.
  • Advanced knowledge of implementation methodologies, SDLC, and enterprise project management.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and teams simultaneously in a matrixed environment.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive presence.
  • Deep expertise in configuring and deploying commercial SaaS platforms.
  • Proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, Asana).
  • Analytical mindset with a focus on problem-solving, risk management, and continuous improvement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a hybrid professional services environment.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies or experience working in agile teams.
  • Certification in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or agile practices (e.g., Scrum Master).
  • Familiarity with customer engagement frameworks and enterprise account management strategies.

Social Discovery Group (SDG) is the 3rd largest social discovery company in the world, uniting 60+ brands with 500 million users. We solve the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection by transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. Our portfolio includes online communication platforms focusing on AI, game mechanics, and video streaming - Dating.com, DateMyAge, Cupid Media, Dil Mil, Kiseki, and others.

SDG invests in IT startups around the world. Our investments include Open AI, Patreon, Flo, Clubhouse, Woebot, Flure, Astry, Coursera, Academia.edu, and many others.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals specializing in the creation and development of globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of 1200 professionals and digital nomads works all over the world.

Our teams of digital nomads work remotely from Cyprus, Malta, the USA, Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Montenegro, Poland, Latvia, Serbia, Spain, Portugal, UAE, Israel, Turkey, Thailand, Indonesia, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia and many other locations.

In August 2024, we achieved Great Place to Work US Certification! This achievement reflects our core belief that a truly exceptional workplace is built on trust, pride, and camaraderie—not just great perks.

We are looking for a Senior CRM Manager to join our team.

Your Main Tasks Will Be

  • Generate hypotheses based on analytical data, customer journey maps (CJM), key business metrics, and lifecycle and loyalty metrics.
  • Create business specifications with measured potential business effects.
  • Launch experiments using classic CRM channels (email, app/web push, SMS) and on-product channels (pop-ups, banners, chats, etc.).
  • Analyse the results of the conducted experiments.
  • Taking ownership of one of the business's most valuable CRM initiatives (increasing retention of high ARPPU clients, preventing churn, etc.).
  • Proactively interact with key stakeholders, product managers, UX teams, development teams, and data analysts.
  • Initiating improvements to processes and products, launching new channels, and using unusual mechanics to achieve business goals.

We Expect From You

  • Experienced with CRM/CDP Systems, HTML, Google Sheets / Excel, Jira / Confluence, Any BI-systems
  • Understanding the main CRM metrics: OR, CR, CTOR, retention rate, churn rate, unsub rate etc.
  • High level of knowledge and experience working with key business metrics: revenue, ARPPU, LTV etc;
  • Strong command of both Russian and English is a must;
  • Experience with SQL would be a plus.

What Do We Offer

  • REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full time;
  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
  • 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
  • Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
  • 50% payment for professional training, international conferences and meetings;
  • Corporate discount for English lessons;
  • Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $ 1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
  • Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $ 1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
  • Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for merch, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!

description:
Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

We are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting‑edge technology, data‑driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve.

About the Role

The Data Engineer will design, build, and maintain the architecture and systems that enable efficient collection, storage, processing, and analysis of data. This role ensures that all company data—including marketing, affiliate, intake, and operational data—flows seamlessly through the system, is stored securely, and is readily accessible for analysis and reporting.

This position requires a skilled engineer with a passion for working with data, solving complex problems, and building systems that support business needs. You will collaborate closely with the Business Intelligence team to ensure that our data infrastructure supports the growing needs of the organization.

Location

Remote (must be available 9 am – 5 pm Eastern Time)

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and store data from multiple internal and external sources.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing, Client Services, Accounting and Business Intelligence teams to ensure data availability and quality for reporting, analysis, and decision‑making.
  • Implement data integrations with platforms like Leadspedia, Retool, Salesforce, Looker, and other internal tools.
  • Ensure the data infrastructure is optimized for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Automate data workflows and processes to reduce manual data handling and improve operational efficiency.
  • Maintain and optimize the company’s data warehouse, ensuring that all data is stored securely and is easily accessible.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data‑related issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal impact on operations.
  • Design and implement data quality controls, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across the company’s systems.
  • Work with the tech team to ensure compliance with data security and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide technical support and guidance for internal teams on data‑related issues and queries.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a related technical field.
  • Strong experience with SQL, Python, and/or other programming languages used for data processing and transformation.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) and tools like BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
  • Proficiency in data integration tools and technologies (ETL processes, data pipelines, API integration).
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and optimizing data workflows for performance.
  • Familiarity with data security practices, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve data issues efficiently.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit‑sharing bonuses based on company performance.
  • 100% company‑paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500‑level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US‑based employees):
    • Medical (Aetna)
    • Dental (Guardian)
    • Vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US‑based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution.
  • 401(k) plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US‑based employees).
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage.
  • Work‑from‑home equipment budget (at company’s discretion).
  • Forever remote work environment.

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast‑paced environments and are driven, client‑focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top‑tier legal representation, we want you on our team.

Estamos construindo uma nova plataforma de chat omnichannel que conecta WhatsApp, chat web e bots de IA em um único ambiente para empresas de energia solar e outros setores.

O sistema combina Spring Boot (modulith + hexagonal) no backend com Next.js no frontend, integrando-se com nossa suíte de produtos (CRM, monitoramento e ticketing).

Desafios da Vaga

Você fará parte de um time que está construindo do zero a base técnica e as principais features da nova geração do nosso produto.

  • Implementar serviços escaláveis e modulares com Spring Modulith, WebFlux, Pub/Sub, Keycloak e OpenTelemetry.
  • Criar interfaces modernas e performáticas em Next.js, com componentização, SSR/ISR, autenticação integrada e chat em tempo real (WebSocket/EventSource).
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura, padrões de código, testes e deploys no GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Pub/Sub, Firestore, etc.).
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com o time de produto, design e IA para entregar experiências de atendimento humano e bot integradas, mensuráveis e confiáveis.

Requisitos

Backend

  • Experiência sólida em Spring Boot com modulith, WebFlux, Pub/Sub e OpenTelemetry.
  • Conhecimento de Keycloak e OpenTelemetry para serviço de autenticação e observabilidade.
  • Domínio de testes unitários, de integração e e2e (JUnit, Testcontainers, K6).

Frontend (Next.js)

  • Experiência sólida em React / Next.js 14+ (App Router, SSR, ISR).
  • Domínio de TypeScript, Zustand/Redux, React Query/TanStack Query.
  • Conhecimento de WebSocket/EventSource e arquiteturas reativas.
  • Experiência em design system e componentização (ex: shadcn/ui, Tailwind).
  • Integração com APIs seguras (OAuth2 / JWT).
  • Testes automatizados (Jest, Playwright, Cypress).

Diferenciais

  • Uso de IA no fluxo de trabalho (LLMs, RAG, n8n).
  • Experiência com produtos SaaS B2B, especialmente chats, CRMs ou contact centers.
  • Experiência com multi-tenant e RBAC.
  • Conhecimento de GraalVM, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub ou Keycloak.
  • Contribuições open source ou projetos pessoais relevantes.

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto com possibilidade de encontros presenciais ocasionais.
  • Contratação PJ.
  • Horário flexível, foco em entregas e colaboração assíncrona.

Processo Seletivo

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products and services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. We share an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy, and Ledn’s suite of products and services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‐based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate has demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security‑first environments and is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. The role also requires strong customer‑support skills and a willingness to help end users who need assistance.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud‑first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About The Role

You will be customer‑facing and the first line of support, owning support and providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.

  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • Owning the experience of tech onboarding for all new employees and tech retrieval for all outgoing employees.
  • Designing, testing, building, and documenting programs, policies and tools, and contributing improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Supporting and managing SaaS applications – Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Managing Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools – MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • Improving IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and automating busywork.
  • Managing, responding to and fixing critical incidents and issues through to completion.

You will work on projects over sprints, detail your work in tools like Jira (you are experienced with agile methods and sprints), and set and work toward your own objectives and key results with minimal direction while aligning them to the team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.

Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc., and to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.

Experience integrating SSO into Okta, creating workflows in Okta, working with APIs, and integrating systems.

Remote support experience across multiple time zones, familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.

Strong communication skills, clear writing, and a desire to provide a magical experience for others.

Security awareness (e.g., PGP) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).

Self‑management, strong organizational and task‑management skills, and the ability to handle ambiguity.

Nice To Haves

Some familiarity with AWS; use of tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces.

Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

Leadership with resilience, adaptability, and a builder’s mindset.

Collaborative partner with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrated integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse cultural contexts.

Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.

Competitive PTO package ensuring you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company through shared equity.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

Clear purpose and support that removes barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. For accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process, requests will be addressed confidentially.

This role is not about managing a single team, but rather about leading initiatives that elevate all teams, improving performance, reliability, developer experience, and consistency across the platform.

We’re looking for someone technically exceptional, socially engaging, and naturally curious, who can connect with engineers across disciplines and inspire technical excellence through collaboration and example.

description:
Analista de Dados BI Sênior - Contrato Temporário

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior com foco em Business Intelligence para integrar o time de dados de um dos nossos clientes.   • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender necessidades analíticas e traduzir essas demandas em soluções de dados escaláveis.
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Monitorar e dar suporte técnico a soluções existentes, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e escalabilidade.
  • Contribuir na definição de boas práticas de BI.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em projetos de BI e análise de dados em ambientes complexos.
  • Domínio de Power BI (Power Query, DAX, modelagem de dados e RLS).
  • Conhecimento em processos de ETL/ELT e integração de dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos, etc.).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) e linguagem SQL.
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Experiência com Data Warehouse, Data Lake ou outras arquiteturas de dados analíticos.

Growth & Digital Strategy

ELVTR is a premier online education platform specializing in live courses led by top executives from globally renowned companies. Our unique approach sets us apart in the online education landscape, offering unparalleled value to our students.

Position Overview

We are seeking a dedicated Student Care Manager to join our team. This role is pivotal in ensuring that our students receive an exceptional educational experience and are fully satisfied with the courses they enroll in. As the frontline of student interaction, you will be instrumental in fostering a supportive and engaging learning environment.

This is a full‑time remote position, open to candidates located anywhere in Brazil.

Ideal Candidate

  • A People Pleaser: You find joy in serving others and are dedicated to ensuring student satisfaction and happiness
  • A Communicator: You have excellent English communication skills and can easily establish rapport with students
  • Tech‑Savvy Troubleshooter: You are comfortable with technology and can perform minor tech troubleshooting, such as assisting someone with difficulties joining a Zoom session
  • Support Champion: You thrive on providing exceptional support and resolving issues to guarantee a seamless educational experience
  • A Community Builder: You excel at fostering a supportive and engaging online environment for student interaction
  • A Facilitator: You are comfortable mediating communication between students and instructors

Responsibilities

  • Direct Support: Engage directly with students to support their needs through phone, email, and online chats
  • Community Engagement: Encourage and maintain student‑to‑student communication, fostering a supportive learning community
  • Instructor Liaison: Ensure clear and effective communication between students and instructors
  • Live Class Assistance: Offer real‑time support to instructors and students during live classes for a seamless educational experience
  • Issue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve student concerns, including technical issues, to ensure uninterrupted learning

Requirements

  • Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Business, Communication, or a related field is preferred
  • High Cognitive Skills: Ability to engage intellectually with our students, demonstrating a deep understanding of our sophisticated educational products
  • Language Proficiency: Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, are mandatory
  • Technical Skills: Must possess a broad understanding of modern online business technologies to efficiently navigate various platforms and tools integral to the role. Proficiency with Asana, CRM tools like HubSpot, Google Sheets, Zoom, and the ability to conduct minor technical troubleshooting is required
  • Presentation Skills: You should be presentable and confident on Zoom, ready to host student meetings
  • Time Management: Ability to manage time and resources effectively, especially in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and Bonuses: We value your dedication and expertise, offering a competitive salary, performance‑based bonuses, and a range of company perks and benefits that reflect our commitment to excellence
  • Exciting Benefits: Enjoy gym membership reimbursements, mental health benefits, generous vacation allowance, and free access to all our courses. We believe in continuous learning, both for our customers and our team
  • Remote work with a Flexible Schedule: The freedom to work remotely, crafting a work‑life balance that fits your personal needs
  • Collaborative Work Environment: Join a team of passionate, like‑minded individuals. At ELVTR, collaboration isn't just a buzzword; it's how we grow, innovate, and excel together

Why You Should Join ELVTR

  • Innovative and Positive Culture: Join a team of passionate individuals who are driven by a common vision
  • Growth Opportunities: At ELVTR, we not only believe in nurturing talent but also in providing abundant opportunities for professional development. In fact, 100% of our senior managers have been promoted to executive roles from within the company
  • A Mission You Can Be Proud of: Be part of a brand that stands for quality, innovation, and inspiring education. Be part of a company that's changing the face of online education, connecting students with top‑tier executives

If you take pleasure in going the extra mile to serve and delight others, and are passionate about providing a top‑tier educational experience, we invite you to apply. Your enthusiasm for customer satisfaction and your knack for resolving issues will make you an invaluable asset to our team.

Due to the high volume of applications, we will only be able to respond to candidates whom we are interested in moving forward with. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to reviewing your application.

ELVTR is committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering a diverse, inclusive environment for all, whether you join us as an employee or a contractor.

Modalidade de Contratação: PJ ou Cooperado

Responsabilidades principais

  • Anotar e preparar datasets de visão computacional.
  • Projetar, treinar, validar e otimizar modelos de deep learning para classificação, detecção e segmentação de imagens.
  • Treinar e implementar modelos YOLO (You Only Look Once) para tarefas de detecção de objetos.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de inferência para execução eficiente em produção.
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps: CI/CD de modelos, versionamento de dados e experimentos, monitoramento e re-treino automático.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de software para integrar os modelos em sistemas e aplicações.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento de Python em quaisquer das bibliotecas de ML/DL (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).
  • Experiência prática com YOLO (treinamento e inferência em problemas de detecção de objetos).
  • Experiência sólida em visão computacional (classificação, detecção, segmentação).
  • Experiência em MLOps com quaisquer das ferramentas: AWS SageMaker Studio, MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, testes automatizados, ambientes reprodutíveis).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em dados estruturados: preparação de dataset, treinamento e inferência em problemas de regressão (ex.: regressão linear, regressão logística, árvores de decisão) e classificação tabular.
  • Análise exploratória de dados estruturados (ex.: Análise das componentes principais - PCA, análise de correlação, clustering com K-Means).
  • Otimização de modelos para edge devices (TensorRT, ONNX, quantização).
  • Contribuições para projetos open source ou publicações técnicas.

Métricas e gráficos que deve saber interpretar

Visão computacional (foco principal): ******, ******:0.95.Curvas Precision-Recall (PR) e AP por classe.Curva ROC e AUC.Matriz de confusão.Curvas de perda e acurácia durante o treinamento.Distribuição de IoU (Interseção Sobre a União).Learning curves (treino vs. validação).

Dados estruturados (como diferencial): Gráficos de resíduos em regressão.Curvas de calibração de probabilidade.Feature importance, SHAP e PDP/ICE plots.Heatmaps de correlação e PCA (scree plot, biplot).

MLOps / produção: Gráficos de detecção de drift de dados.Distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).Métricas de latência/throughput.Consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.
